main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The gnosis of Christ as the key to transcend the material plane
header_desc: The meeting of the Condor and the Eagle symbolizes the definitive union between science and spirituality, allowing us to understand that human consciousness is not a byproduct of the body but a fundamental property of the Universe. It is precisely the Primordial Consciousness that has the mission of reintroducing gnosis, revealing that each brain hemisphere is linked to a different plane of the cosmos: the timeless and divine corresponds to the pneuma, while the temporal and material belongs to the psyche. This shows that what the Christian tradition defines as the <q>rapture</q> is essentially a spiritual awakening known as the <q>Return to the Divine Unity</q>.
left_title: The Awakening of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth 🧠 to the Kingdom of the ONE ❤️
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The EGO possesses mass and creates the temporal-material illusion of the psyche 🧠; to counteract it, the cosmos offers us a Universal Consciousness, timeless and non-spatial — the ONE — that allows us to return to the divine timelessness of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere — our pneuma — resides the timeless and divine plane; the high-frequency spiritual plane | 999⟩ is the origin of the cosmos where the Invisible Father dwells. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ — represented by Pistis Sophia and associated with the right hemisphere ❤️ —, and the physical |EGO⟩ — represented by the Demiurge Yaldabaoth and associated with the left hemisphere 🧠 —. This shows us that we possess a free will of perception, which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE ❤️|EGO 🧠⟩, reaffirming the maxim <q>The Kingdom of God is within you</q> (Gospel of Thomas, logion 3).
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency physical plane | 666⟩; the end of the cosmos where Yaldabaoth resides. There is a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and all of humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle { footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)}
cap1_desc: Premise and framework of integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and the spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and the mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(01:13 -- 02:42)}
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why the laws of Newton and Maxwell do not distinguish between past and future, the breaking of Einstein's simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_title: Chapter 3: Consciousness and Space-Time { footnotesize color{golddark}(02:47 -- 05:19)}
cap3_desc: The conceptual assembly Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field beyond space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_title: Chapter 4: Gnosis and Material Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(05:27 -- 08:39)}
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi discovery (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as a prison for the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas but to free the inner spark from the Demiurge's prison through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Demiurge's Prison { footnotesize color{golddark}(08:43 -- 10:16)}
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth — also known as the great architect of matter — is the creator of the sensible world, a self-centered god unaware of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the awakening spark.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres { footnotesize color{golddark}(10:23 -- 14:38)}
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, versus Jesus's revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos { footnotesize color{golddark}(14:40 -- 16:30)}
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox comes down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos — with its more than two trillion galaxies — it is there where the phrase of Jesus resonates more strongly: "The Father and I are one." Could this have had a hidden message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in heaven and tracking the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity.</q>
